title: Russell Targ coming around to remote viewing as precognition
summary: Eric Wargo tells of Russell Targ coming around to remote viewing as precognition, about unspecified at remote viewing community, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think Russell targ even has sort of come around to that idea

plain: Eric Wargo, a writer on dreams and seeing the future, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that remote viewing, the claimed ability to describe faraway places with the mind alone, may really be precognition, knowing things before they happen. He says he thinks even Russell Targ, a physicist who helped lead government-funded remote viewing research, has sort of come around to that idea.
